authored_by: Implementing agent (Claude Code, claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-13, BEFORE any Google provider output existed. Not an expert or legal adjudication. The author had read Contract A, the V1 recordings and the V2 inducer; development was not blind.
independence_warning: The reviewers/blind model (claude-opus-5-5) and the checklist author are Claude-family models. Agreement is not independent confirmation. Use the checklist to make omissions and wrong transfers visible for human adjudication, not to certify correctness.

scoring_rubric.recovered: A material element is recovered when a condition's final extraction has a slot entry whose verbatim quote overlaps the element's anchor (normalized substring either way, at least 8 characters) AND whose slot name is in the element's acceptable_slots. Quote overlap without an acceptable slot is reported separately as anchor_only.
scoring_rubric.recall: recovered / material elements per packet; counts only (n=3 packets), never rates generalized beyond this run.
scoring_rubric.wrong_transfer: A slot entry whose value or quote contains a contamination marker (a Contract A literal that is not a fact about Contract B). Critical when the slot is in critical_slots.
scoring_rubric.unsupported_assertion: Slot entries with quotes that are not verbatim substrings are rejected at validation and counted as field errors; they never reach scoring.
scoring_rubric.unmatched_reviewer_challenge: An omitted_conditions item whose quote overlaps no checklist anchor. Needs human adjudication; it is NOT automatically a false challenge.
scoring_rubric.hold: HOLD_UNRESOLVED is reported separately from recall and is not a quality score.
scoring_rubric.human_adjudication: Every count is PENDING human review before any claim of interpretation accuracy.
